## 3dslibris 3.0.0

This release adds word and phrase search with the built-in 3DS keyboard, and zoom for images inside ebooks.

### Improvements

* [#163](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/163): search EPUB, MOBI, TXT, Markdown, FB2, RTF and ODT books from the `search` option in the BOOK menu.
  * Search ignores case and keeps accents, with an optional `whole words` setting. Matches are highlighted, including across lines, screens and pages.
  * Use L/R for the previous or next match, X to edit the search, and A/B to return to reading. B cancels a pending search without moving the page. Searches wrap once at the end of the book.
  * Search runs incrementally to keep controls responsive, and keeps the query only for the current book session.
  * CJK is supported; leave `whole words` off for text without spaces. Traditional/simplified Chinese, kana and character-width variants are not interchangeable. Input depends on the console's system keyboard.
  * Queries are limited to 128 UTF-16 units. RTL (Arabic/Hebrew), PDF/CBZ/XPS and OCR search are unsupported; reordered passages in mixed RTL text are skipped. Matches cannot cross images, structural separators or separate XHTML documents.

* [#28](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/28): enlarge images in EPUB, MOBI and FB2 without losing your reading position. Hold Y to select an image and press A to open it; zoom, pan or move with the stylus, then Y to return. Linked images keep X to follow the link. The viewer includes touch buttons for zoom, fit, back, library and settings.

* Add a global `disable ebook images` toggle under `style customization`, off by default. It skips images in EPUB, MOBI and FB2 without reserving their layout space; library covers are kept. Changing it repaginates affected books.

* Load folder covers only when visible and the library is idle, and reuse their thumbnail cache when returning. CBZ decoding also avoids an extra copy of the compressed image.

EPUB and MOBI page caches are rebuilt automatically on first open for search and layout changes. Saved progress and preferences are kept.

### Bug fixes

* Keep loading screens in portrait until the book is ready, and wrap long filenames safely.
* Fix image-viewer buttons clipped in landscape and give their labels enough padding. Move large figures to the next screen instead of shrinking them into the remaining space beside their captions.
* Respect screen orientation and handedness in menu navigation, PDF/XPS panning and overview touch.
* Use each reading screen's dimensions for ebook image widths, percentage-based image sizes and `vw`, separators and pagination. Keep MOBI headings with the following text in both reading orientations.
* Show two lines for book titles in the library list.
* Correct sepia gradients after rotation and preserve surrounding content when redrawing part of the screen.
* [#165](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/165): prevent a stack overflow during first-time book pagination with CJK fonts such as Noto Sans CJK KR.
* Handle soft hyphens and manual page changes during search, and enable the keyboard option needed for kanji input on Japanese systems.
* Bound image loading memory on book pages as well as in the zoom viewer, and avoid loading the whole MOBI file to look up an image.
* Handle empty RTL ranges, invalid settings selections and missing selection pages safely, and fix an undefined integer shift when decoding embedded images.
* Respect swapped search controls, preserve keyboard requests interrupted by HOME, and clip search outlines correctly at screen edges. A failed search start returns to the editor with an error.
* Reject incomplete or corrupt EPUB page/search caches, including invalid document and anchor page references.
* Check decoded FB2 image allocations before storing resources, and retain cached image variants with different dimensions.
* Keep each image's authored width independent when the same resource appears more than once, including after reopening from cache.
* Reject cover images outside the existing size limits before decoding their pixels, keeping the previous thumbnail if loading fails.
